dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a continuous convex spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point, lacking any concave falcation or notched morphology.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification; the apex terminates in a narrow, high-frequency point with a minimal radius of curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour is exceptionally steep, maintaining a nearly vertical orientation of approximately 85 degrees relative to the dorsal horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High verticality; the ratio of the fin's maximum vertical pixel height to its visible base width is approximately 3:1.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal fin exhibits an exceptionally erect, spike-like morphology with a distinct linear vertical transition in pigmentation between the darker anterior and lighter posterior regions.
